title: Support full-screen mode when it fits the experience

statement.en: Support full-screen mode when it helps people concentrate on a task or become immersed in content.
statement.ja: taskへの集中やcontentへの没入に役立つ場合はfull-screen modeに対応する。

conditions: Consider it for games, media, and in-depth tasks that benefit from a distraction-free environment.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Going full screen experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
